meta.title: NOSTALGIA Map v2 - railways (2003)
meta.format: sections = track centrelines [lat, lon] between junctions (simplified, <= 140 vertices); services = routes as section lists; stations = platform centre [lat, lon]

confidence_rules.high: from data / several agreeing sources (OSM platform or DataMeet+MMTS list within 150 m)

attribution: Map reference: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data (CC BY 4.0) and (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
Track geometry: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via Overture Maps Foundation, release 2026-09-23.0
Stations: DataMeet Indian Railways data (CC0, github.com/datameet/railways), OSM platforms via Lakeer hyderabad-open-gis-data (OSM, ODbL), Lakeer MMTS stop list
meta.era_note: All these lines existed in 2003 (broad gauge). The metro lines in the OSM data (2017+) were excluded. MMTS suburban trains started in August 2003 on the Lingampally-Hyderabad/Secunderabad and Falaknuma-Secunderabad routes; the small MMTS halts were new then.
